theme: Light mode preferred for data-heavy dashboard readability. Use neutral grays and stark contrast.

rules: Color should communicate performance, not category. Do not make 'Environment' inherently green and 'Governance' inherently purple.
Categories must use neutral styling (e.g., slate grays).
Hover states must be a lighter hue of the active state. Never rely on inheritance.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (The Tactile Variant) - Mix soft shadows with sharp 1px inner borders for dashboards.
visual_enhancers.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift and shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle nested borders. Child border-radius should be less than parent.

layouts.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)
layouts.overview_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 for summary cards.
layouts.attention_required_section: Use an alert-style block or compact card layout with distinct emphasis (warning icon, neutral background).

kpi_cards.description: Suppliers assessed, Avg ESG Score, Top Performer, Needs Attention.
kpi_cards.style: Minimalist card, large numeric value, subtle label.

summary_cards.description: Three compact cards replacing the donut chart: Excellent, Good, Needs Attention.
summary_cards.style: Show the semantic score dot/icon, title, and count of suppliers.

top_performing_bars.description: Supplier score bars with the score value at the end of the bar.
top_performing_bars.style: Horizontal progress bar. Use the semantic score color based on value. Score aligned to the right of the bar.

supplier_ranking_table.description: Hierarchical rows replacing flat rows. Show main supplier info with sub-categories below.
supplier_ranking_table.style: Row structure: Top line -> Supplier name, Medal (if applicable), Overall Score, Band Name (Excellent/Good). Bottom line -> Neutral text 'Environment 100 · Social 50 · GHG 99.4'. On row hover, show 'View ->' action button on the far right.
supplier_ranking_table.status_formatting: Display richer status (Not Started, Invited, In Progress, Submitted, Under Review, Completed, Overdue). Show 'x / y questions' for 'In Progress'.

tooltip.usage: Use an info icon next to 'Overall Score' in table headers. Content: 'Combined ESG + GHG performance score'.

motion.hover_states: Row hover shows the 'View ->' action via opacity transition (opacity-0 to opacity-100).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' ONLY for colors/opacity, NOT transforms universally.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all semantic score colors have > 3:1 contrast against their backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements, key KPI values, table rows, and buttons MUST include data-testid. Examples: 'kpi-suppliers-assessed', 'supplier-row-{id}', 'view-supplier-btn'.

icons.usage: Use semantic icons for status. Info icon for tooltips. Arrow-right for View action.

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove the Overall Score/GHG Intensity dropdown completely. Hardcode the logic to display Overall Score.
Refactor the Overview dashboard to remove the donut chart and add the 3 summary compact cards.
Implement Top Performing Suppliers horizontal bars using standard divs with percentage width or Shadcn Progress component.
Add 'Attention Required' section clearly calling out missing assessments or scores needing attention.
Update the table structure to be hierarchical. The top row of a cell has the main name and score; the bottom row has category breakdown separated by middle dots (·).
Make category texts neutral colors (e.g., text-slate-500) and remove previously hardcoded category colors.
Add a hover effect on table rows that reveals a 'View ->' link or button on the right side.
Integrate Shadcn Tooltip component for the 'Overall Score' column header.
Ensure all components use `data-testid` for testing.
universal_guidelines: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Never use complete transparent background in header or overlays.
Add micro-interactions like hover states and transitions.
Follow the semantic scoring system strictly for score displays.
Write code for React JS (.js) rather than TSX.
